title: Laboratory Fee Schedule Pricing on Observation Stays — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Pricing methodology bulletin.** The laboratory pricing values codes 84484, 85025 and 80053 under revenue code 0300 on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), each read by its billed units as well as its charges, when the retained value is figured on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

| Payer class and account class | Value of each code |
|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim for an Observation Stay Account | its billed units times its clinical laboratory fee schedule amount times 1.35 |
| Commercial PPO Claim for an Observation Stay Account | the lesser of its billed units times its schedule amount times 1.6 and its charges |
| otherwise | the payer class's expected allowed percentage of their charges |

| Code | Clinical laboratory fee schedule amount (USD per unit) |
|---|---|
| 84484 | 12.96 |
| 85025 | 7.77 |
| 80053 | 10.56 |

The three codes together are never valued above their billed charges.

Example (hypothetical): on a Commercial PPO Claim for an Observation Stay Account, 2 units of 84484 charged 20.00 (schedule value 2 times 12.96 times 1.6 is 41.472, so the charges of 20.00 apply) and 1 unit of 85025 charged 30.00 (schedule value 7.77 times 1.6 is 12.432, below the charges) are valued at 32.432 together. The same codes on an Emergency Department Visit Account fall under "otherwise".
